kind: read-only Python occurrence identity crosswalk; no ledger ID rewrite or status mutation
identityMethod: Resolve each old ledger ID in the original complete export; verify path/rule/originalLine and originalSourceLine against exact Git baseline bytes.
Join exports on path, rule, begin/end line and column, diagnostic title, and the shared source revision. Title is required because different mypy diagnostics share coordinates.
Retain oldIds as an array. For 13 identical duplicate pairs, no arbitrary old ID is called the survivor; both map to the single corrected diagnostic.
All 228 corrected diagnoses have exact signature matches. This establishes identity equivalence, not a fresh remediation or remote-rescan pass.

schemaNotes.interpretation: The overview artifact alone cannot show which schema fields its producer accepts. Any explicit future adapter must support entries/status as well as the crosswalk. The Python ledger itself was not rewritten.

caveats: Both exports advertise be8 as latestCommitOid; local baseline source-line checks corroborate ledger source alignment, but this report does not independently attest cloud execution provenance.
ledgerReviewedFileSha256 is retained as historical review evidence; it is not a claim that the current integrating worktree still has those exact bytes.
13 removed occurrences are duplicate multiplicity, not13 unique resolved findings. All provider IDs rotated, so choosing 13 specific old IDs as the deleted survivors would be arbitrary.
